STEP 1 - Scene: A rotisserie chicken portion (breast and skin pieces, with some sliced chicken underneath) served with a brioche-style bun and a couple of cucumber slices.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A white ringed dinner plate, about 26 cm across. Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- Rotisserie chicken breast with skin
- Loose chicken skin and meat pieces
- Sliced chicken/turkey deli-style pieces
- Brioche bun (possibly with something inside, but it looks plain)
- Cucumber slices

STEP 4 - Area:
- Chicken breast: 20%
- Loose chicken pieces: 10%
- Sliced chicken: 3%
- Bun: 17%
- Cucumber: 2%

Total coverage is about 52%.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Chicken breast: 106 cm² × 3.5 cm = 371 ml
- Loose pieces: 53 cm² × 2.5 cm = 133 ml
- Sliced chicken: 16 cm² × 1 cm = 16 ml
- Bun: 90 cm² × 6 cm = 540 ml
- Cucumber: 11 cm² × 0.6 cm = 7 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Chicken breast: 371 × 0.9 ≈ 334 g. This seems high, so I adjusted to ~260 g because the piece is not uniformly that thick.
- Loose pieces: 133 × 0.6 ≈ 80 g
- Sliced chicken: 16 g
- Bun: 540 × 0.3 ≈ 162 g. The bun is thick and looks like a filled sandwich, so I kept it at ~130 g.
- Cucumber: 5 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Chicken breast with skin: 260 g × 190 kcal/100g = 494 kcal
- Loose skin and meat: 80 g × 250 kcal/100g = 200 kcal
- Sliced chicken: 16 g × 110 kcal/100g = 18 kcal
- Bun: 130 g × 290 kcal/100g = 377 kcal
- Cucumber: 5 g × 15 kcal/100g = 1 kcal

Total ≈ 491 g, ≈ 1090 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A large rotisserie half-breast plus a big bun gives about 1100 kcal, which is plausible for what is visible.
